summaryForMax:
Where this stands at 188809f: the pure-logic (unit) layer is fully green — AC1's ORRERY/HELM reducer table (body-cycling, BURN gating, nav-autopilot toggle, auto-warp timers) passed 36/36 targeted tests plus the full 1247-test suite, 3/3 adversarial reviewers confirmed it. Nothing here needed live-driving.

AC2-AC7 all landed in code (commits 78a94ad, a6548f9, 188809f) and are structurally sound on static/code-path review — every seam traced to its wiring, all headless tests green, build clean — but every one of them is a `live:true` integration AC, meaning this verification pass was explicitly barred from opening a browser to check them. That's not a finding against the work; it's the pass being unable to close these on its own. Working-Claude (main thread) needs to drive these six live next:
- AC2 instant-framed-entry: enter an ORRERY system via star-click+Space, nav-computer burn, and mobile double-tap/speed-dial — confirm no warp cinematic (no shake, no warpEffect), instant framed cut, pilotPhase IDLE, camBypassed false.
- AC3 no-auto-warps-in-orrery: sit through the title-end (~3:16) and nebula-linger (15s) windows while in ORRERY — confirm no auto-warp fires; confirm it still fires normally in HELM.
- AC4 burn-hidden-no-silent-swap: in ORRERY, select ship/planet/star/moon targets and try BURN via button, Space, and nav-computer — confirm the button never appears and nothing silently swaps station/target; confirm HELM still shows BURN as before.
- AC5 click-click-view-glide: click a body once (select), click again (camera glides smoothly, never snaps, never welds to ship); confirm ships are select-only.
- AC6 midboot-nav-selection-wins: pick a new nav target mid-warp both before and after FOLD — confirm player's choice wins pre-FOLD and gets stashed/redirected at reveal post-FOLD, with the original boot target never silently completing.
- AC7 screensaver-rearm-bounds: let an autopilot tour complete hands-off in ORRERY and confirm it does NOT auto-loop; confirm F-key takeover and Z-key re-arm still behave correctly in HELM.

For you, Max, on AC8 (the only AC you decide): once working-Claude reports those six live checks green, launch the game yourself and judge whether ORRERY mode feels coherent as one whole flow — no ship-authority sneaking in while browsing (instant cuts, no surprise auto-warps, BURN never appearing), the double-click glide feeling smooth and not disorienting, mid-boot nav choices behaving sensibly, and tours not looping past their end. Watch specifically for anything that technically "passes" a checklist but feels janky or incoherent in actual play — that's the gap only your eyes can close.
